name: AirVPN
hq_jurisdiction: Italy (secondary source only; vendor pages not readable)
logging_claim: Secondary source reports vendor states a zero-logs policy; vendor's own policy page could not be read

name: Astrill VPN
parent_company: Veloxee Corp. (Astrill is a brand of Veloxee Corp.)
logging_claim: Vendor calls its policy 'no-logs' but discloses: session data (connection time, IP, device type, app version) is kept only during the VPN session and removed after disconnect; total bytes transferred per account are counted; the last 20 connection records per account (time, duration, country, device, app version) are kept for support; data may be kept longer in case of suspected misuse. Says server design does not let it see which sites users access.
refund_window: None: vendor states all sales are final and refunds are not possible once purchase is made (routers have a separate warranty replacement/credit)

name: Atlas VPN
parent_company: Nord Security (announced deal to add Atlas VPN to its portfolio on 2021-10-15; Nord Security blog calls Atlas VPN 'a valued member of the Nord Security family')

name: CyberGhost
parent_company: CyberGhost S.R.L.; ultimate holding company stated as Kape Technologies PLC
ultimate_owner: Teddy Sagi (via Kape Technologies) - per Wikipedia only, not confirmed on vendor pages
logging_claim: Vendor states strict no-logs: no browsing history, traffic logs, IP assignments or connection timestamps; enforced with RAM-only servers and verified by Deloitte.
ram_only_servers: RAM-only servers stated (share of fleet not specified)
refund_window: 45 days for 6-month/2-year plans; 14 days for 1-month plan

name: ExpressVPN
parent_company: Express Technologies Ltd.; ultimate holding company stated as Kape Technologies PLC
ultimate_owner: Teddy Sagi (via Kape Technologies) - per Wikipedia only, not confirmed on vendor pages
logging_claim: Vendor states it does not and will not keep logs of online activity or personal information (browsing history, traffic destination/metadata, DNS queries).
ram_only_servers: all servers (TrustedServer runs only on volatile memory/RAM, per vendor)
refund_window: 30 calendar days from initial purchase (new subscribers only; not for renewals)

name: hide.me
parent_company: eVenture Limited (operator; no higher parent stated)
hq_jurisdiction: Malaysia (registered office Labuan F.T.; reg. no. LL09685)
logging_claim: States it does not keep logs of VPN sessions, browsing behaviour, visited websites, or connection timestamps matching incoming/outgoing IPs or session duration.
refund_window: 30 days from start of plan; must notify in writing by email; full refund subject to conditions listed in terms (e.g. not exceeding usage conditions; conditions truncated in review)

name: Hotspot Shield
parent_company: Pango Group (Intersections LLC / Pango GmbH, d/b/a Pango Group), which merged with Total Security in Dec 2024 and rebranded as Point Wild (per press coverage; Point Wild press page returned 403 to me)
logging_claim: VPN products do not log information associating account credentials or identity with VPN session activity, and keep no records of websites or apps accessed. (URL is the 29 Sep 2022 version of the policy; current version at legal.hotspotshield.com returned 403.)
refund_window: 45 days from enrollment when purchased directly from vendor (homepage statement); the 2019 ToS version (terms20191510) only mentions pro-rated refunds and refers to Section 9, so current terms not verified

name: IPVanish
parent_company: Ziff Davis
hq_jurisdiction: United States (privacy policy lists 360 Park Avenue South, New York; parent Ziff Davis, Inc.)
logging_claim: IPVanish says it does not log traffic content/destinations, browsing, DNS queries or app usage; it does retain username, starting IP, session start time, duration and traffic volume to prevent abuse. The same policy also lists 'connection time stamps' among things it does not retain; both statements are on the page.
ram_only_servers: partial (IPVanish says it is transitioning and on track to be 100% RAM-only by 2027)
refund_window: 30 days from purchase for yearly or 2-year plans; monthly plans not covered automatically

name: IVPN
parent_company: IVPN Limited
ultimate_owner: Nicholas Pestell (founder, CEO and 100% owner of IVPN Limited, per IVPN)
logging_claim: IVPN says it retains no connection logs or session data and stores no customer information beyond what is needed; it says it cannot associate a request with a customer identity.
ram_only_servers: in progress (May 2025 IVPN post says the infrastructure upgrade including transition to RAM-only servers was under way with test deployments; completion not verified)
refund_window: Full refund within 30 days of payment, once per account and per customer

name: Mullvad VPN
parent_company: Amagicom AB
ultimate_owner: Fredrik Strömberg and Daniel Berntsson (100% owners of Amagicom AB and Mullvad VPN AB, per Mullvad)
logging_claim: Mullvad states it does not keep activity logs of any kind; accounts are anonymous random numbers with no email or personal data.
ram_only_servers: all VPN servers (Mullvad says RAM-only migration completed September 2023)
refund_window: 14-day money-back guarantee, starting when payment is made

name: NordVPN
parent_company: Nord Security
hq_jurisdiction: Panama (NordVPN service, per vendor no-logs page); parent Nord Security headquartered in Lithuania
logging_claim: Vendor states it does not keep logs of user activity (no browsing history, IP, DNS queries or downloaded files); says its no-logs policy has been independently verified six times.
ram_only_servers: all servers (vendor says all server data is stored in RAM, no traditional hard drives)
refund_window: 30-day money-back guarantee for new subscriptions (initial purchase only; renewals not eligible)

name: Private Internet Access
parent_company: Kape Technologies (named in PIA privacy policy; Kape's RNS of 16 Dec 2019 confirms completion of its acquisition of LTMI Holdings, the company behind PIA per the announcement title 'Completion of Private Internet Access Acquisition')
ultimate_owner: Teddy Sagi (via Kape Technologies) - per Wikipedia only, not confirmed on vendor pages
hq_jurisdiction: United States (PIA Private Internet Access, Inc., Denver, Colorado)
logging_claim: Vendor says it never records or stores online activity, connection info or metadata; cites RAM-only servers, US court proceedings, and Deloitte audits. Says the only personal information kept is the sign-up email, payment details and ZIP code (required for US tax purposes).
ram_only_servers: all servers (vendor: systems run entirely on RAM-only servers)

name: PrivateVPN
parent_company: Miss Group Holdings Ltd (reported acquirer of PrivateVPN Global AB, 13 Jun 2022; secondary source only, not confirmed on vendor pages)
hq_jurisdiction: Sweden (PrivateVPN Global AB, reg. no. 559282-2182, Ytterby; terms under Swedish law)
logging_claim: States it does not collect or store logs of activity: no browsing history, traffic destination, connection timestamps, DNS queries, or allocated/connected IP addresses, or data content.
refund_window: 30 days; new customers only, cancel before end of 30th day; reason must be given; refunds processed within 5 business days

name: Proton VPN
parent_company: Proton AG
ultimate_owner: Proton Foundation (non-profit; primary shareholder of Proton AG)
logging_claim: Vendor states it keeps no logs of online activity and stores no metadata (no visited pages, session lengths or IP monitoring); verified by Securitum audits.
refund_window: 30 days from initial purchase; once per user, direct purchases only

name: PureVPN
parent_company: GZ Systems Private Ltd (as named in the privacy policy; Intershore Chambers, P.O. Box 4342, Road Town, Tortola, British Virgin Islands)
hq_jurisdiction: British Virgin Islands (vendor states it moved HQ there, citing no mandatory data retention laws)
logging_claim: Vendor says it does not keep any logs that can identify or help monitor a user's activity, and stores no activity/usage logs, so it would have nothing to share even if compelled.
refund_window: 31 days from initial purchase; does not apply to renewal payments

name: StrongVPN
parent_company: J2 Global / Ziff Davis (per Wikipedia J2 Global article, secondary source; not verified against Ziff Davis filings)

name: Surfshark
parent_company: Surfshark B.V.; in 2022 merged with Nord Security under one holding company (operating independently)
logging_claim: Vendor says it keeps its VPN logs-free: no visited IPs, browsing history, session info, connection timestamps, bandwidth or traffic; some connection data is deleted within 15 minutes after a session ends.
refund_window: 30-day money-back guarantee from initial purchase (exclusions for some resellers, prepaid cards, add-ons)

name: Trust.Zone
parent_company: Internet Privacy Ltd (operator; no higher parent stated). Tersys Group OU (Estonia) acts only as authorized payment distributor.
hq_jurisdiction: Seychelles (operator address Victoria, Mahe; terms governed by Seychelles law)
logging_claim: States its VPN servers do not store any log files and that, having no connection logs, it could not associate a request with a customer even if compelled.
refund_window: 10-day money-back guarantee on first paid subscription bought directly on trust.zone; written request within 10 days of purchase

name: TunnelBear
parent_company: McAfee (acquired TunnelBear in 2018; operating entity TunnelBear LLC)
logging_claim: TunnelBear says it collects only minimal operational data and keeps no login timestamps or logs of user activity.
refund_window: 30-day money-back guarantee, first year of annual subscriptions bought directly from tunnelbear.com; otherwise non-refundable except at TunnelBear's discretion

name: VyprVPN
parent_company: Certida LLC
hq_jurisdiction: United States (Austin, Texas; Certida LLC address)
logging_claim: Golden Frog's policy says VyprVPN is zero-log: it does not record or retain data when the service is used, including assigned IP, connection times or traffic (policy dated March 2021).
refund_window: 30-day money-back guarantee for annual and monthly subscriptions, if cancelled within 30 days of first payment (Golden Frog terms; current Certida terms not readable)

name: Windscribe
parent_company: Windscribe Limited
logging_claim: Windscribe says it keeps no identifying logs: no historical record of who used which IP, only limited non-identifying data (last-used date, 30-day bandwidth total).
ram_only_servers: all servers (Windscribe says entire infrastructure runs RAM-only)
refund_window: Initial payment refundable if requested within 7 business days (TL;DR says 7 days) of subscription start and usage under 10 GB

name: ZenMate
parent_company: Kape Technologies Plc (100% share acquisition of ZenGuard GmbH announced 2018-10-16)
ultimate_owner: Teddy Sagi via Unikmind Group (Kape takeover by Unikmind agreed Jan 2023 at 285p/share; Sagi already held about 55%). Completion of the take-private not separately verified.
hq_jurisdiction: Germany (operating entity ZenGuard GmbH, Amtsgericht Berlin-Charlottenburg HRB 151355 B; imprint lists Carlstrasse 50, 52531 Uebach-Palenberg)
logging_claim: Site homepage advertises a 'strict no-logs policy'; full privacy policy not read.
